svg.title: Harbor Goods Well-Architected and DevOps assessment: evidence to roadmap
svg.desc: Interviews, a credential report, deployment and incident exports and read-only reviews become one cited answer per best practice. The offline wa_assess scripts score the six pillars and the DevOps lens, count 8 high-risk and 21 medium-risk issues per question, rank 49 gaps into a backlog by risk and effort, and schedule a 30/60/90-day roadmap and report; make verify reproduces every number.

g.text: every gap: owner, effort, evidence ID
Interviews and read-only evidence, cited by ID
58 best practices scored · risk per question
49 gaps ranked by risk, then effort
